text:
Priya (Sales): Heads up — ACME wants to close the POC + orderform today but legal/finance need clarifications on SLA and billing. Can you weigh in?
Marco (Legal): Which SLA clause did they redline? share the excerpt. If they removed the error budget language we need to restore something.
Priya (Sales): They changed '99.95%' to '99.99%' availability and removed the section on 'graceful degradation / fallback'. Also asking for credits tied to downtime minutes.
Marco (Legal): 99.99% is enterprise level and implies serious engineering commitments. Propose this compromise language: "Service Availability target: 99.95% monthly; credits defined as percentage of monthly fees with a 3-month rolling window." I'll paste suggested text if you want.
Janelle (Finance): From billing side — finance flagged Net30 vs Net45. They requested Net45 and a PO referencing our invoice code. We can accept Net45 for a committed annual contract, but POC/orderform needs up-front 50% prepay. Any workaround?
Ethan (Solutions): For the POC we can limit the committed throughput: 4 v100-equivalent GPUs, up to 1M tokens/day. If they push for 99.99% at that size we need warm standby + multi-region routing. That's extra cost.
Priya (Sales): OK — ACME is flexible on prepay. They want a clear SLA with credit calc and an explicit list of endpoints covered. They also want SOC2 evidence and a completed security questionnaire returned with the order.
Marco (Legal): I'll prepare a redline with two options: (A) 99.95% with credit schedule; (B) 99.99% but only for Dedicated/Dedicated-plus and with a surcharge. Which one should I send?
Janelle (Finance): Send option A for commercial close. We can mark option B as 'require dedicated commitment and pricing table' to be handled post-PO. Finance needs final invoice name + tax info to generate PO.
Ethan (Solutions): Attaching the orderform snippet we recommend for POC — please confirm before Marco finalizes legal.
```
order_form_item: ACME POC
model_tier: dedicated-provision
capacity: 4 x v100-equivalent
period: 30 days
price: $18,000 (50% prepay)
slab: up to 1M tokens/day
```
Priya (Sales): @Marco please include a short bullet that the SLA only applies to production endpoints listed in the order form (not internal admin endpoints). @Janelle I'll DM you customer billing legal name + tax.
Marco (Legal): Will do. Also adding fallback clause: "If model capacity constrained, traffic will be routed to compatible fallback model; credits only apply when no fallback is available." That avoids customer claiming credits during planned capacity shuffles.
contract-bot: DocuSign envelope created for orderform 291111 — link: https://docusign.example.com/envelope/0xabc123 (status: sent)
Priya (Sales): Nice — pinging ACME procurement to ask for PO and SOC2 report. @Ethan can you provide an SOC2 pointer and the standard security questionnaire export (pdf)?
Ethan (Solutions): I can pull SOC2 attestation and the latest questionnaire export by EOD. Will upload to the shared drive and send link here.
Janelle (Finance): Once we have customer PO and signed orderform, I'll process invoice. Marking internal task: set payment terms Net45 and annotate billing code ACME-PO-7789.
Priya (Sales): Summary action items: Marco — send redline option A + note about option B. Ethan — upload SOC2 + questionnaire. Janelle — prepare PO template for Net45 + 50% prepay invoice. I'll follow up with ACME procurement. :thumbsup:
Marco (Legal): Copy. I'll drop the redline in the thread in 30 mins.
Ethan (Solutions): Uploading docs now. link: https://drive.example.com/acme/poc-security.zip
Priya (Sales): Thanks team — let's aim to close by EOD.
